sentences.text:
Nitesh @ Nanu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 January,
2023
Author: Anjuli Palo

Bench: Anjuli Palo
In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur Cra No. 4791 of 2022 (Nitesh @
Nanu Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others) Dated : 19-01-2023

entities.text: High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri L.N. Sakle
- Advocate for appellant.
Shri Purshottam Soni - Panel Lawyer for State.
None for the objector.
Record of the Court below has been received.
Heard on admission.
Admit.
Also heard on I.A. No.10132/2022, which is first application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant.

Appellant has been convicted by the trial Court under Section 457 of IPC and sentenced to R.I. for 3 years with fine of Rs.500/-, Section 376 of IPC and sentenced to R.I. for 10 years with fine of Rs.500/-, Section 506-II of IPC and sentenced to R.I. for 1 year with fine of Rs.500/- and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act and R.I. for 10 years with fine of Rs.500/- respectively, with default stipulations.
As per the prosecution case, age of the prosecutrix was 17 years 11 months at the time of incident.
In the medical examination, the Doctor did not find any sign of violence on the person of the prosecutrix.
Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that trial Court has committed error in not appreciating the evidence available on record in proper perspective and in convicting the appellant.
It is further contended that the prosecutrix was a consenting party.
He further submits that the applicant is aged about 22 years, he is a first offender and is in custody since 15.01.2019.
Disposal of this appeal would take considerable time, therefore, jail sentence of appellant be suspended and he may be released on bail.
Learned Panel Lawyer for the State has opposed the bail application and prays for its rejection.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

Looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and taking into account that the age of the prosecutrix was 17 years and 11 months and age of the appellant is 22 years, appellant is in custody since 15.01.2019 and disposal of this appeal would take considerable time, without commenting upon the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

Nitesh @ Nanu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144574607/
1 I t is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, remaining jail sentence imposed upon appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of this case and he shall be released on bail.
The appellant shall appear before the trial Court concerned on 06.07.2023 and on all such subsequent dates, as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
List for final hearing in due course.
(SMT. ANJULI PALO) JUDGE Nitesh Nitesh @ Nanu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144574607/
